subject: RMySQL on shiny and hosting apps locally

messages.author: ad0479edfa13e0ad
messages.subject: RMySQL on shiny and hosting apps locally
parts:
Hi all,

1) I just developed an app that uses the RMySQL package to access a local MySQL database and retrieve data.

When I am running my app from RStudio everything works fine. However, when I try to access the app through the standalone shiny server, I get an error :

"The application unexpectedly exited.
Diagnostic information has been dumped to the JavaScript error console."

Note that every other app that I host with shiny server that doesn't include the RMySQL package, runs smoothly on the server.

So is there a malfunction between the shiny server and RMySQL package? And if it does, how about the RODBC package (for accessing Microsoft databases)?

2) Any guidance on how to access my app from another machine within my LAN network?


Thanks in advance guys
